# NPM Configuration File
# This file configures npm behavior for the smart-village-app/sva-studio project
#
# provenance: Enables npm provenance statements during package publishing
# When set to true, npm will generate and publish provenance attestations that cryptographically
# verify the package's source code origin and build process. This enhances supply chain security
# by providing transparent and verifiable metadata about where and how the package was built.
# Requires npm 9.5.0 or higher and a supported CI/CD environment.
provenance=true
---
cleanupUnusedCatalogs: true
injectWorkspacePackages: true
linkWorkspacePackages: true
preferWorkspacePackages: true
engineStrict: true
nodeVersion: 24.15.0
minimumReleaseAge: 1440
minimumReleaseAgeIgnoreMissingTime: false
minimumReleaseAgeStrict: true
trustPolicy: no-downgrade
trustPolicyExclude:
  # Legacy toolchains in the current Nx/Babel/TanStack plugin graph still resolve semver 6.3.1.
  # Remove this exact-version exception once the transitive graph no longer requires semver 6.x.
  - semver@6.3.1
blockExoticSubdeps: true
allowBuilds:
  '@google/genai': true
  bufferutil: true
  esbuild: true
  msw: false
  nx@22.7.1 || 22.7.4 || 23.0.1 || 23.0.2 || 23.1.1: true
  protobufjs: false
  sharp: true
overrides:
  # Keep @ai-sdk/provider-utils unpinned here: Stagehand 3.6.0 still resolves against
  # the AI SDK v2/v3 provider graph, and the old 5.0.2 override forced an incompatible tree.
  "@tanstack/react-router": "1.170.24"
  "@tanstack/react-start": "1.168.41"
  "@tanstack/router-core": "1.171.20"
  "@tanstack/router-plugin": "1.168.28"
